question: Approve the design and enter implementation? Approving accepts D1 (an opt-in security extension: for a prod task FO dispatches kc-pr-flow's tob-security-reviewer unchanged at the ideation gate and at the validation gate), D2 (narrow relay's 'specialists are risk-selected' sentence for security only, recorded as your ruling for relay's FO to apply in relay's own README, not in this PR) and D3 (tob-actions-auditor and tob-supply-chain-checker not in the first cut), each as recommended, and the stop rule: the worker revises the review brief at most twice and the extension does not ship if AC-3 and AC-4 still fail. It also accepts the batch-1 implementation order (names-check-before-dispatch lands before extension-instruction-reaches-dispatch, which edits the same dispatch_records.py function; the other three run in parallel), and is the grant for the implementation worker to push a branch and open a Draft PR.

artifacts.summary: Design: opt-in `security` extension; no workflow text or script changes; no new reviewer built. Replay on relay agent-front-door, one run per cell: the threat-model brief found both Medium findings on the relay design but raised a HIGH on a control design with nothing exposed; adding an attacker boundary removed the false HIGH but missed unbounded writes, so the brief is not settled (AC-3 and AC-4) and the stop rule bounds it. Cost: 57k to 98k tokens per ideation-gate run; validation-gate run unmeasured (relay reported about 7 minutes). FO reads about 423 more words at each gate prep only for a listing prod task; base bytes at every other moment. Not verified: run-to-run variance. design_surfaces.py check exit 0.
